message.content: The yellowing started about four days ago, and it's been getting steadily worse since then. My stools have been dark over the same time. I've felt very tired and lightheaded too. I haven't had any belly pain, fever, or cough, and I haven't noticed any bleeding. I wasn't asked about itching, nausea, or weight loss in a way I can add details on, so I don't have anything to report there.
